examples.chinese: 我感冒了，頭很痛，眼睛、耳朵也不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, tóu hěn tòng, yǎnjing, ěrduo yě bù shūfu.
examples.english: I caught a cold; my head hurts a lot, and my eyes and ears are also uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 我咳嗽、頭痛，鼻子也不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ késou, tóu tòng, bízi yě bù shūfu.
examples.english: I have a cough and headache. Also my nose is uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 醫生說那個病人得住院，要是三天以內都沒發燒、頭也不痛了，就可以出院了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nàge bìngrén děi zhùyuàn, yàoshi sān tiān yǐnèi dōu méi fāshāo, tóu yě bú tòng le, jiù kěyǐ chūyuàn le.
examples.english: The doctor said that patient has to be hospitalized; if within three days he has no fever and his head no longer hurts, then he can be discharged.

examples.chinese: 聽說坐月子時不能洗頭髮，要不然對身體不好，你相信這樣的說法嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zuòyuèzi shí bùnéng xǐ tóufa, yàobùrán duì shēntǐ bù hǎo, nǐ xiāngxìn zhèyàng de shuōfǎ ma?
examples.english: I heard that during confinement you can't wash your hair, otherwise it's bad for your health. Do you believe this version?

examples.chinese: 週末我帶孩子們去鄉下玩，他們餵小羊吃草，拿饅頭給猴子吃，玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ dài háizimen qù xiāngxià wán, tāmen wèi xiǎoyáng chī cǎo, ná mántou gěi hóuzi chī, wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: On the weekend, I took the children to the countryside to play; they fed the lambs grass and gave steamed buns to the monkeys to eat, and they had a great time.

examples.chinese:
地震時要保護自己的安全，最重要的是避免頭部受傷。
當地震發生時，我們應該怎麼做呢？
examples.pinyin:
Dìzhèn shí yào bǎohù zìjǐ de ānquán, zuì zhòngyào de shì bìmiǎn tóubù shòushāng.
Dāng dìzhèn fāshēng shí, wǒmen yīnggāi zěnme zuò ne?
examples.english:
During an earthquake, you must protect your own safety; the most important thing is to avoid head injury.
When an earthquake occurs, what should we do?

examples.chinese: 這個地區是個危險地帶，因為經常一下雨就有石頭掉下來，有時候連路都會塌了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū shì ge wēixiǎn dìdài, yīnwèi jīngcháng yí xià yǔ jiù yǒu shítou diào xiàlái, yǒu shíhou lián lù dōu huì tā le.
examples.english: This area is a dangerous zone, because whenever it rains, rocks often fall, and sometimes even the road collapses.

examples.chinese: 小李進公司的頭三個月，每天上班要花兩個小時，後來搬到公司附近，走路十分鐘就到了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jìn gōngsī de tóu sān ge yuè, měi tiān shàngbān yào huā liǎng ge xiǎoshí, hòulái bān dào gōngsī fùjìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
examples.english: For the first three months after Xiao Li joined the company, it took him two hours to commute every day; later he moved near the company, and it took only ten minutes to walk there.

examples.chinese: 天空突然下起了大雨，我的衣服和頭髮都濕了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānkōng tūrán xià qǐ le dà yǔ, wǒ de yīfu hé tóufa dōu shī le.
examples.english: Suddenly it started raining heavily, and my clothes and hair all got wet.

examples.chinese: 我到德國留學的頭兩個星期，因為對環境不環境而迷過幾次路，後來就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dào Déguó liúxué de tóu liǎng gè xīngqī, yīnwèi duì huánjìng bù shúxī ér mí guò jǐ cì lù, hòulái jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: In the first two weeks of studying in Germany, because I was not familiar with the environment, I got lost a few times; later there was no problem.

examples.chinese: 小陳認為頭痛是小事，況且最近忙得連休息的時間都不夠，所以不肯去看病。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Chén rènwéi tóutòng shì xiǎoshì, kuàngqiě zuìjìn máng de lián xiūxi de shíjiān dōu bù gòu, suǒyǐ bù kěn qù kànbìng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Chén thinks a headache is a small matter; furthermore, recently he has been so busy that he doesn't even have enough time to rest, so he refuses to see a doctor.

examples.chinese: A:「快時尚」的服裝只有剛出來的頭幾個月受歡迎。 B:哦？你的意思是「快時尚」的衣服很快就失去魅力了嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: “Kuàishíshàng” de fúzhuāng zhǐyǒu gāng chūlái de tóu jǐ ge yuè shòu huānyíng. B: Ó? Nǐ de yìsi shì “kuàishíshàng” de yīfu hěn kuài jiù shīqù mèilì le ma?
examples.english: A: “Fast fashion” clothing is only popular for the first few months after it comes out. B: Oh? Do you mean that “fast fashion” clothes quickly lose their charm?

examples.chinese:
我爺爺年紀大了，不但體力不好，還有頭痛、肩膀痛的毛病。
我家的洗衣機用了二十多年了，毛病真不少，可是媽媽還不肯換新的。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ yéye niánjì dà le, bùdàn tǐlì bù hǎo, hái yǒu tóutòng, jiānbǎng tòng de máobìng.
Wǒ jiā de xǐyījī yòng le èrshí duō nián le, máobìng zhēn bù shǎo, kěshì māma hái bù kěn huàn xīn de.
examples.english:
My grandpa is old; not only is his physical strength poor, but he also has the problem of headaches and shoulder pain.
Our washing machine has been used for over twenty years and has quite a few problems, but Mom still won't agree to replace it with a new one.

examples.chinese:
不知道明哲今天怎麼了？老師叫了他好幾次，他就像木頭一樣，沒有反應。
九二一大地震發生得太突然，不少民眾因為來不及反應，而被困在屋裡。
examples.pinyin:
Bù zhīdào Míngzhé jīntiān zěnme le? Lǎoshī jiào le tā hǎojǐ cì, tā jiù xiàng mùtou yíyàng, méiyǒu fǎnyìng.
Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn fāshēng de tài tūrán, bùshǎo mínzhòng yīnwèi láibují fǎnyìng, ér bèi kùn zài wū lǐ.
examples.english:
I don't know what's wrong with Mingzhe today? The teacher called him several times, but he was like a piece of wood, without any reaction.
The 921 earthquake happened too suddenly; many people were trapped inside their houses because they didn't have time to react.

examples.chinese: 付完學費，我的獎學金只剩下三千塊，這個月只有吃饅頭過日子了。
examples.pinyin: Fù wán xuéfèi, wǒ de jiǎngxuéjīn zhǐ shèng xià sānqiān kuài, zhège yuè zhǐyǒu chī mántou guò rìzi le.
examples.english: After paying the tuition, I only have 3000 dollars of my scholarship left; this month I can only live on steamed buns.

examples.chinese: 天氣變涼了，奶奶頭痛的毛病又犯了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì biàn liáng le, nǎinai tóutòng de máobìng yòu fàn le.
examples.english: The weather has turned cool, and Grandma's headache problem has occurred again.

examples.chinese: 康先生把這塊木頭刻成了一隻鳥，這個藝術作品完成後，還能放在美術館呢！
examples.pinyin: Kāng xiānsheng bǎ zhè kuài mùtou kè chéng le yī zhī niǎo, zhège yìshù zuòpǐn wánchéng hòu, hái néng fàng zài měishùguǎn ne!
examples.english: Mr. Kang carved this piece of wood into a bird; after this artwork is finished, it can even be placed in an art museum!

examples.chinese: 中國南北方的飲食習慣有一些差異，南方人多吃米飯，北方人多吃餃子、饅頭等麵食。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó nánběifāng de yǐnshí xíguàn yǒu yīxiē chāyì, nánfāng rén duō chī mǐfàn, běifāng rén duō chī jiǎozi, mántou děng miànshí.
examples.english: There are some differences in eating habits between northern and southern China: southerners eat more cooked rice, while northerners eat more dumplings, steamed buns, and other wheat-based foods.

items.wordHook: a 豆(beans) basket sits above the 頁(head) → balanced on your 頭(head).

examples.chinese: 我父親是保險公司的經理，要管理很多員工。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn shì bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ, yào guǎnlǐ hěn duō yuángōng.
examples.english: My father is a manager at an insurance company and has to manage many employees.

examples.chinese: 為了做這個報告，經理已經跟我們開過三次會了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zuò zhège bàogào, jīnglǐ yǐjīng gēn wǒmen kāi guò sān cì huì le.
examples.english: In order to prepare this report, the manager has already had meetings with us three times.

examples.chinese: 張經理不但常加班，還要做市場研究，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ bùdàn cháng jiābān, hái yào zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, měitiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Manager Zhang not only often works overtime but also has to do market research; every day he is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: 同事都走了，只剩下他一個人還在做事。他是廣告公司的經理，每天要做好多事，忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Tóngshì dōu zǒu le, zhǐ shèngxià tā yí ge rén hái zài zuòshì. Tā shì guǎnggào gōngsī de jīnglǐ, měitiān yào zuò hǎo duō shì, máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: The colleagues have all left; only he is left still working. He is a manager at an advertising company; every day he has to do a lot of work and is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: 我在車站遇到以前的同事，他現在是一家保險公司的經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài chēzhàn yùdào yǐqián de tóngshì, tā xiànzài shì yì jiā bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ.
examples.english: I ran into a former colleague at the station; he is now a manager at an insurance company.

examples.chinese: 下個星期我要和經理一起到美國去出差。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqī wǒ yào hé jīnglǐ yìqǐ dào Měiguó qù chūchāi.
examples.english: Next week I will go to the US on a business trip together with the manager.

examples.chinese: 老闆很滿意小陳的工作表現， 明年要請他當經理呢！這次的比賽很重要，大家一定要好好地表現。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn hěn mǎnyì Xiǎo Chén de gōngzuò biǎoxiàn, míngnián yào qǐng tā dāng jīnglǐ ne! Zhè cì de bǐsài hěn zhòngyào, dàjiā yídìng yào hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
examples.english: The boss is very satisfied with Xiao Chen's work performance and wants to ask him to be the manager next year! This competition is very important; everyone must perform well.

examples.chinese:
經理說，我們要一邊說笑話一邊介紹機器的功能，這樣子才賣得好。
小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！
examples.pinyin:
Jīnglǐ shuō, wǒmen yào yībiān shuō xiàohua yībiān jièshào jīqì de gōngnéng, zhèyàngzi cái mài de hǎo.
Xiǎo Jiǎn shì yīge yǒu àixīn, yǒu lǐmào de rén, xiàng zhèyàngzi de nánrén nǐ yào hǎohǎo bǎwò a!
examples.english:
The manager said, we need to tell jokes while introducing the machine's functions, this way it will sell well.
Xiao Jian is a caring and polite person; a man like this, you should hold on to him!

examples.chinese:
東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。
我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。
examples.pinyin:
Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng.
Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.
examples.english:
Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance.
My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理提到公司打算做市場研究，希望大家下次能發表自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ tí dào gōngsī dǎsuàn zuò shìchǎng yánjiū, xīwàng dàjiā xiàcì néng fābiǎo zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: At today's meeting, the manager mentioned that the company plans to do market research, and hopes everyone can express their own ideas next time.

examples.chinese:
那位大明星身上穿的、手上戴的 ，都是有名的牌子。
經理做事態度認真、負責，我從他身上學到了很多做人做事的道理。
examples.pinyin:
Nà wèi dà míngxīng shēnshang chuān de, shǒushang dài de, dōu shì yǒumíng de páizi.
Jīnglǐ zuòshì tàidù rènzhēn, fùzé, wǒ cóng tā shēnshang xué dào le hěn duō zuòrén zuòshì de dàolǐ.
examples.english:
What that big star wears on her body and on her hands are all famous brands.
The manager's work attitude is serious and responsible; I have learned many principles of how to conduct myself and do things from him.

examples.chinese: 經理這次願意採用新員工的建議，讓我們都嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhè cì yuànyì cǎiyòng xīn yuángōng de jiànyì, ràng wǒmen dōu xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: The manager is willing to adopt the new employee's suggestion this time, which gave us all a start.

examples.chinese: 我舅舅在公司的表現樣樣都好，所以老闆打算明年讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiùjiu zài gōngsī de biǎoxiàn yàngyàng dōu hǎo, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn dǎsuàn míngnián ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: My uncle's performance at the company is good in every aspect, so the boss plans to make him manager next year.

examples.chinese:
那輛汽車突然從路口開了出來， 把我嚇了一跳。
聽說經理後天就要離開公司了。 這個消息太突然了，大家一時沒辦法接受。
examples.pinyin:
Nà liàng qìchē tūrán cóng lùkǒu kāi le chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yī tiào.
Tīngshuō jīnglǐ hòutiān jiù yào líkāi gōngsī le. Zhège xiāoxi tài tūrán le, dàjiā yīshí méi bànfǎ jiēshòu.
examples.english:
That car suddenly drove out from the intersection and startled me.
I heard that the manager is leaving the company the day after tomorrow. This news is too sudden; everyone couldn't accept it for a moment.

examples.chinese: 這個星期經理一連寫了三個推銷新產品的計畫，每天都忙得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xīngqī jīnglǐ yīlián xiě le sān gè tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn de jìhuà, měi tiān dōu máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: This week the manager wrote three plans for promoting new products in succession; he is extremely busy every day.

examples.chinese: 張經理今天的工作行程安排得很滿，連吃飯、休息的時間都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ jīntiān de gōngzuò xíngchéng ānpái de hěn mǎn, lián chīfàn, xiūxi de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: Manager Zhang's work schedule today is arranged very full; he doesn't even have time to eat or rest.

examples.chinese:
我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。
經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī.
Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english:
My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of.
The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: 今天開會時，經理表面上對老闆很客氣，其實心裡很不高興。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kāihuì shí, jīnglǐ biǎomiàn shàng duì lǎobǎn hěn kèqi, qíshí xīnlǐ hěn bù gāoxìng.
examples.english: During the meeting today, the manager was superficially very polite to the boss, but actually he was very unhappy inside.

examples.chinese:
許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。
你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin:
Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn.
Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english:
Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient.
There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese:
學生與校長當面對話，希望學校改善教學設備和校園餐廳的服務品質。
聽到老闆跟經理的對話，我才知道公司新產品的銷售成績不理想。
examples.pinyin:
Xuéshēng yǔ xiàozhǎng dāngmiàn duìhuà, xīwàng xuéxiào gǎishàn jiàoxué shèbèi hé xiàoyuán cāntīng de fúwù pǐnzhí.
Tīngdào lǎobǎn gēn jīnglǐ de duìhuà, wǒ cái zhīdào gōngsī xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu chéngjì bù lǐxiǎng.
examples.english:
Students had a face-to-face dialogue with the principal, hoping the school would improve teaching equipment and the service quality of the campus cafeteria.
Only after hearing the dialogue between the boss and the manager did I realize that the sales performance of the company's new product was not ideal.

examples.chinese: 石經理對員工很兇，回家後卻能表現出溫柔的一面，非常體貼太太。
examples.pinyin: Shí jīnglǐ duì yuángōng hěn xiōng, huíjiā hòu què néng biǎoxiàn chū wēnróu de yí miàn, fēicháng tǐtiē tàitai.
examples.english: Manager Shi is very fierce to employees, but after going home he can show a gentle aspect and is very considerate of his wife.

examples.chinese: 明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de zhǔguǎn huìyì zài sān lóu de huìyìshì jǔxíng, jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā búyào chídào.
examples.english: Tomorrow's supervisor meeting will be held in the meeting room on the third floor; the manager requires everyone not to be late.

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese:
想當年，出國留學的日子雖然很忙，卻很充實。
算算日子，剩下兩個星期經理就要退休了。
明天是我父母結婚三十年的重要日子，一定要好好地慶祝。
examples.pinyin:
Xiǎng dāngnián, chūguó liúxué de rìzi suīrán hěn máng, què hěn chōngshí.
Suàn suàn rìzi, shèngxià liǎng ge xīngqī jīnglǐ jiù yào tuìxiū le.
Míngtiān shì wǒ fùmǔ jiéhūn sānshí nián de zhòngyào rìzi, yídìng yào hǎohǎo de qìngzhù.
examples.english:
Thinking back to those days, although the days of studying abroad were busy, they were very fulfilling.
Counting the days, there are only two weeks left before the manager retires.
Tomorrow is the important day of my parents' thirtieth wedding anniversary; we must celebrate it well.

examples.chinese: 他曾替公司談成了三億美元的生意，因此老闆讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Tā céng tì gōngsī tán chéng le sān yì měiyuán de shēngyì, yīncǐ lǎobǎn ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: He once negotiated a three-hundred-million-dollar deal for the company, so the boss made him manager.

examples.chinese: 經理因商品售完而跟顧客道歉，並表示明天就會補上。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ yīn shāngpǐn shòu wán ér gēn gùkè dàoqiàn, bìng biǎoshì míngtiān jiù huì bǔ shàng.
examples.english: The manager apologized to the customer because the product was sold out, and indicated that it would be restocked tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 經理對新產品計畫的指示不太清楚，我們最好去問清楚。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ duì xīn chǎnpǐn jìhuà de zhǐshì bù tài qīngchu, wǒmen zuì hǎo qù wèn qīngchu.
examples.english: The manager's instructions about the new product plan are not very clear; we'd better go ask and clarify.

examples.chinese: 開會前經理要求大家勿開手機，專心討論會議內容。
examples.pinyin: Kāihuì qián jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā wù kāi shǒujī, zhuānxīn tǎolùn huìyì nèiróng.
examples.english: Before the meeting, the manager asked everyone not to turn on their cell phones and to focus on discussing the meeting content.

examples.chinese: 連經理很講話，開會時老是說個不停，別人都沒說話的分。
examples.pinyin: Lián jīnglǐ hěn jiǎng huà, kāihuì shí lǎoshì shuō gè bù tíng, biérén dōu méi shuōhuà de fèn.
examples.english: Manager Lian talks a lot; during meetings he never stops talking, and others have no share of the speaking.

examples.chinese: 他上禮拜去買電腦，差點就忘了自己的手機，真糊塗！
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng lǐbài qù mǎi diànnǎo, chàdiǎn jiù wàng le zìjǐ de shǒujī, zhēn hútú!
examples.english: Last week he went to buy a computer and almost forgot his own cell phone—really silly!

examples.chinese: 他上禮拜去買電腦，差點兒就忘了自己的手機，真糊塗！
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng lǐbài qù mǎi diànnǎo, chàdiǎnr jiù wàng le zìjǐ de shǒujī, zhēn hútú!
examples.english: Last week he went to buy a computer and almost forgot his own cell phone—so forgetful!

examples.chinese: 小藍看起來糊里糊塗的，其實做起事來仔細得很。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolán kàn qǐlái húlǐhútú de, qíshí zuò qǐ shì lái zǐxì de hěn.
examples.english: Xiaolan looks muddle-headed, but actually she is very careful when doing things.

examples.chinese: 任何人都應該認真思考自己的未來，別糊里糊塗地過日子。
examples.pinyin: Rènhé rén dōu yīnggāi rènzhēn sīkǎo zìjǐ de wèilái, bié húlǐhútú de guò rìzi.
examples.english: Everyone should seriously think about their own future, and not live their days muddleheadedly.

examples.chinese: A:我太糊塗了，忘了把變更後的網路銀行密碼記下來。 B:這下子你得親自去銀行處理了。
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ tài hútu le, wàng le bǎ biàngēng hòu de wǎnglù yínháng mìmǎ jì xiàlái. B: Zhè xiàzi nǐ děi qīnzì qù yínháng chǔlǐ le.
examples.english: A: I was too careless and forgot to write down the changed internet banking password. B: Now you'll have to go to the bank in person to deal with it.

examples.chinese: 經過我的說明，他反而有些糊塗了，看來我的解釋不太清楚。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò wǒ de shuōmíng, tā fǎn'ér yǒuxiē hútú le, kànlái wǒ de jiěshì bù tài qīngchu.
examples.english: After my explanation, he actually became somewhat confused; it seems my explanation wasn't very clear.

examples.chinese: 小朋友！別吵架、別打架了，有話好好地說。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyou! Bié chǎojià, bié dǎjià le, yǒu huà hǎohǎo de shuō.
examples.english: Kids! Stop arguing and stop fighting; if you have something to say, say it nicely.

examples.chinese: 小朋友！別吵架、別打架了，有話好好地說。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyou! Bié chǎojià, bié dǎjià le, yǒu huà hǎohǎo de shuō.
examples.english: Kids! Stop arguing and stop fighting; if you have something to say, say it nicely.

examples.chinese:
我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。
那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne.
Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english:
When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought.
That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese:
我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。
那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne.
Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english:
When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought.
That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: 一聽說颱風快來了，許多民眾就去超市搶購蔬菜、水果、泡麵等食物。
examples.pinyin: Yì tīngshuō táifēng kuài lái le, xǔduō mínzhòng jiù qù chāoshì qiǎnggòu shūcài, shuǐguǒ, pàomiàn děng shíwù.
examples.english: As soon as they heard that a typhoon was coming, many people rushed to the supermarket to buy vegetables, fruit, instant noodles, and other foods.

examples.chinese: 這兩個國家因為搶石油資源，而把對方當成了敵人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge guójiā yīnwèi qiǎng shíyóu zīyuán, ér bǎ duìfāng dāngchéng le dírén.
examples.english: These two countries, because they are fighting over oil resources, have regarded each other as enemies.

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的衛生紙打八折，很多人搶著購買。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge páizi de wèishēngzhǐ dǎ bā zhé, hěn duō rén qiǎng zhe gòumǎi.
examples.english: This brand of toilet paper is 20% off; many people are rushing to buy it.

items.wordHook: A greedy raider's 扌(hand) breaks into the communal grain 倉(granary) to loot and 搶(rob).

examples.chinese: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.
examples.english: Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working.

examples.chinese: 前面發生了交通意外，為了避免被困在路上，我們還是走別條路吧。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn fāshēng le jiāotōng yìwài, wèile bìmiǎn bèi kùn zài lùshàng, wǒmen háishì zǒu bié tiáo lù ba.
examples.english: There was a traffic accident ahead; to avoid being stuck on the road, we should take another route.

examples.chinese:
因為有人喝酒後開車，造成了嚴重的交通意外，警察和救護車都趕來了。
不管出國工作或留學，一定得買個平安保險，萬一發生什麼意外才能得到幫助。
examples.pinyin:
Yīnwèi yǒu rén hējiǔ hòu kāichē, zàochéng le yánzhòng de jiāotōng yìwài, jǐngchá hé jiùhùchē dōu gǎnlái le.
Bùguǎn chūguó gōngzuò huò liúxué, yīdìng děi mǎi gè píng'ān bǎoxiǎn, wànyī fāshēng shénme yìwài cái néng dédào bāngzhù.
examples.english:
Because someone drove after drinking, it caused a serious traffic accident; both the police and ambulance rushed over.
Whether going abroad to work or study, you must buy safety insurance so that in case any accident happens, you can get help.

examples.chinese: 大學給我一封正式的信，通知我得到獎學金了。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué gěi wǒ yì fēng zhèngshì de xìn, tōngzhī wǒ dédào jiǎngxuéjīn le.
examples.english: The university gave me a formal letter notifying me that I have received a scholarship.

examples.chinese: 我收到了健身中心的通知，下個月就要去當健身教練了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shōudào le jiànshēn zhōngxīn de tōngzhī, xià gè yuè jiù yào qù dāng jiànshēn jiàoliàn le.
examples.english: I received a notification from the fitness center; next month I will go be a fitness coach.

examples.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 有了捷運以後，台北市的交通情況改善了很多。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiéyùn yǐhòu, Táiběi Shì de jiāotōng qíngkuàng gǎishàn le hěn duō.
examples.english: After the MRT came, Taipei City's traffic situation improved a lot.

examples.chinese: 這裡的交通有很大的改變，比以前方便多了。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jiāotōng yǒu hěn dà de gǎibiàn, bǐ yǐqián fāngbiàn duō le.
examples.english: The transportation here has undergone a big change; it's much more convenient than before.

examples.chinese: 我妹妹非常喜愛像Hello Kitty那樣的卡通人物。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei fēicháng xǐ'ài xiàng Hello Kitty nàyàng de kǎtōng rénwù.
examples.english: My younger sister really likes cartoon characters like Hello Kitty.

examples.chinese: 這附近有捷運站和公車站，交通很便利。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fùjìn yǒu jiéyùn zhàn hé gōngchē zhàn, jiāotōng hěn biànlì.
examples.english: There are MRT and bus stations near here; the transportation is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 因為最近常常下雪，所以交通很不方便。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi zuìjìn chángcháng xià xuě, suǒyǐ jiāotōng hěn bù fāngbiàn.
examples.english: Because it has often been snowing recently, transportation is very inconvenient.

examples.chinese: 從我家去捷運站，過一條街就到了，交通很方便。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā qù jiéyùn zhàn, guò yì tiáo jiē jiù dào le, jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: From my home to the MRT station, cross one street and you're there; the transportation is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 這裡的環境不錯，可是附近沒有捷運站，交通不方便。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de huánjìng bùcuò, kěshì fùjìn méiyǒu jiéyùn zhàn, jiāotōng bù fāngbiàn.
examples.english: The environment here is not bad, but there is no MRT station nearby, transportation is not convenient.

examples.chinese: 這個城市一連下了五天的雨，造成很多地區淹水，三分之一的路不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yīlián xià le wǔ tiān de yǔ, zàochéng hěnduō dìqū yānshuǐ, sān fēn zhī yī de lù bù tōng le.
examples.english: It rained for five days in a row in this city, causing flooding in many areas, and one third of the roads are impassable.

examples.chinese: 背包客為了解省交通費，經常搭別人的車到下一個地點。
examples.pinyin: Bèibāokè wèile jiéshěng jiāotōng fèi, jīngcháng dā biérén de chē dào xià yí ge dìdiǎn.
examples.english: In order to save on transportation costs, backpackers often hitch rides in other people's cars to the next place.

examples.chinese: 我在山上工作，手機的訊號很弱，朋友常抱怨我的電話不是打不通，就是聲音不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài shānshàng gōngzuò, shǒujī de xìnhào hěn ruò, péngyǒu cháng bàoyuàn wǒ de diànhuà bú shì dǎ bù tōng, jiù shì shēngyīn bù qīngchu.
examples.english: I work in the mountains, and the cell phone signal is very weak. My friends often complain that my phone either can't be reached or the voice is unclear.

examples.chinese: 便利的交通，不僅縮短了南北城市的距離，也節省了人們寶貴的時間。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì de jiāotōng, bùjǐn suōduǎn le nánběi chéngshì de jùlí, yě jiéshěng le rénmen bǎoguì de shíjiān.
examples.english: Convenient transportation has not only shortened the distance between northern and southern cities, but also saved people's precious time.

examples.chinese:
氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。
老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin:
Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn.
Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english:
The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs.
The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: 每個人的想法、看法都不一樣，要是遇到意見不同時，就應該好好地溝通。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de xiǎngfǎ, kànfǎ dōu bù yīyàng, yàoshi yùdào yìjiàn bùtóng shí, jiù yīnggāi hǎohǎo de gōutōng.
examples.english: Everyone's thoughts and views are different; if you encounter a difference of opinion, you should communicate well.

examples.chinese:
公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。
地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin:
Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng.
Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english:
The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it.
Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 佳佳認為談戀愛的對象，年齡不重要，容不容易溝通、個性適不適合才是最重要的。
examples.pinyin: Jiājiā rènwéi tán liàn'ài de duìxiàng, niánlíng bù zhòngyào, róng bù róngyì gōutōng, gèxìng shì bù shìhé cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
examples.english: Jiajia believes that for a romantic partner, age is not important; whether it is easy to communicate with them and whether their personality suits you are the most important things.

examples.chinese: 金先生最近遇到了很不幸的事，他的父母在一場交通意外中去世了。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiānsheng zuìjìn yùdàole hěn búxìng de shì, tā de fùmǔ zài yì chǎng jiāotōng yìwài zhōng qùshì le.
examples.english: Mr. Jin recently encountered a very unfortunate event: his parents died in a traffic accident.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方不算偏僻，但是附近沒有公車站，所以自行車成了我最常利用的交通工具。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng bù suàn piānpì, dànshì fùjìn méiyǒu gōngchēzhàn, suǒyǐ zìxíngchē chéng le wǒ zuì cháng lìyòng de jiāotōng gōngjù.
examples.english: The place I live is not considered remote, but there is no bus stop nearby, so the bicycle has become the transportation tool I use most often.

examples.chinese:
我伯伯說，讀書與做人同樣重要，也是一輩子的事。
與人溝通時，最重要的是讓對方清楚了解你想表達的意思。
examples.pinyin:
Wǒ bóbo shuō, dúshū yǔ zuòrén tóngyàng zhòngyào, yě shì yībèizi de shì.
Yǔ rén gōutōng shí, zuì zhòngyào de shì ràng duìfāng qīngchǔ liǎojiě nǐ xiǎng biǎodá de yìsi.
examples.english:
My uncle says that studying and being a good person are equally important, and are lifelong matters.
When communicating with others, the most important thing is to let the other person clearly understand what you want to express.

examples.chinese: 這個地區的交通非常混亂，尤其是車多人多的上下班時間。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū de jiāotōng fēicháng hùnluàn, yóuqí shì chē duō rén duō de shàngxiàbān shíjiān.
examples.english: The traffic in this area is very chaotic, especially during rush hour when there are many cars and people.

examples.chinese: 小明順利通過了大學考試，今年就是一年級的新生了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shùnlì tōngguò le dàxué kǎoshì, jīnnián jiù shì yī niánjí de xīnshēng le.
examples.english: Xiaoming successfully passed the university exam; this year he is a freshman.

examples.chinese:
那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。
這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin:
Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi.
Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english:
The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically.
This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 自從有了高速鐵路，不僅縮短了交通時間，人與人之間的距離也變近了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le gāosù tiělù, bùjǐn suōduǎn le jiāotōng shíjiān, rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de jùlí yě biàn jìn le.
examples.english: Ever since there has been high-speed rail, not only has travel time been shortened, but the distance between people has also become closer.

examples.chinese: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
examples.pinyin: A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Zhème zhòngdà de juédìng, wèishénme xiànzài cái tōngzhī wǒmen?
examples.english: A: Starting tomorrow, the company will no longer provide free three meals. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?

examples.chinese:
站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。
「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin:
Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le.
Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english:
The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow.
Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

examples.chinese: 如果同事之間不願意溝通，這個會議怎麼開下去呢？
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ tóngshì zhījiān bú yuànyì gōutōng, zhège huìyì zěnme kāi xiàqù ne?
examples.english: If colleagues are unwilling to communicate with each other, how can this meeting continue?

examples.chinese: 有時候孩子不明白自己到底犯了什麼錯，父母應該好好跟他們溝通。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushíhou háizi bù míngbai zìjǐ dàodǐ fàn le shénme cuò, fùmǔ yīnggāi hǎohǎo gēn tāmen gōutōng.
examples.english: Sometimes children don't understand what mistake they have actually made; parents should communicate well with them.

examples.chinese: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
examples.pinyin: Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.
examples.english: If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods.

examples.chinese: 這座城市不但交通十分便利，生活水準也很高，大家都想搬來這裡住。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì bùdàn jiāotōng shífēn biànlì, shēnghuó shuǐzhǔn yě hěn gāo, dàjiā dōu xiǎng bān lái zhèlǐ zhù.
examples.english: Not only is transportation in this city extremely convenient, but the standard of living is also very high; everyone wants to move here to live.

examples.chinese: 上次我出國旅行時，護照被偷了，幸好導遊通知了當地的外交人員，很快就辦好了新護照。
examples.pinyin: Shàngcì wǒ chūguó lǚxíng shí, hùzhào bèi tōu le, xìngkuī dǎoyóu tōngzhī le dāngdì de wàijiāo rényuán, hěn kuài jiù bàn hǎo le xīn hùzhào.
examples.english: Last time I traveled abroad, my passport was stolen; fortunately, the tour guide notified the local diplomatic personnel, and a new passport was quickly issued.

examples.chinese: 人類的智慧表現在思考、溝通、欣賞、創造等方面。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi de zhìhuì biǎoxiàn zài sīkǎo, gōutōng, xīnshǎng, chuàngzào děng fāngmiàn.
examples.english: Human wisdom is manifested in aspects such as thinking, communication, appreciation, and creation.

examples.chinese: 今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ xuéxiào fùjìn fāshēng le chēhuò, jīngguò jǐngchá chǔlǐ hòu, xiànzài jiāotōng yǐ huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: This morning a car accident occurred near the school. After the police handled it, traffic has now returned to normal.

examples.chinese:
為了提高這座城市的文化水準，市長積極建設藝術表演中心、圖書館等公共空間。
像機場、高鐵、捷運這類公共交通建設，都需要很多經費才能完成。
examples.pinyin:
Wèile tígāo zhè zuò chéngshì de wénhuà shuǐzhǔn, shìzhǎng jījí jiànshè yìshù biǎoyǎn zhōngxīn, túshūguǎn děng gōnggòng kōngjiān.
Xiàng jīchǎng, gāotiě, jiéyùn zhè lèi gōnggòng jiāotōng jiànshè, dōu xūyào hěn duō jīngfèi cái néng wánchéng.
examples.english:
In order to raise the cultural level of this city, the mayor actively builds public spaces such as art performance centers and libraries.
Public transportation construction such as airports, high-speed rail, and MRT requires a lot of funds to complete.

examples.chinese: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.
examples.english: In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans.

examples.chinese:
由於每個人看事情的角度不同，所以得溝通才能避免誤會。
那個模特兒個子高、長得美，從什麼角度拍都漂亮。
examples.pinyin:
Yóuyú měi gè rén kàn shìqíng de jiǎodù bùtóng, suǒyǐ děi gōutōng cái néng bìmiǎn wùhuì.
Nàge mótè'ér gèzi gāo, zhǎng de měi, cóng shénme jiǎodù pāi dōu piàoliang.
examples.english:
Because each person's point of view on things is different, communication is necessary to avoid misunderstandings.
That model is tall and beautiful; from whatever angle you photograph her, she looks pretty.

examples.chinese: 他在我們公司負責的業務是交通意外保險。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài wǒmen gōngsī fùzé de yèwù shì jiāotōng yìwài bǎoxiǎn.
examples.english: The business he is responsible for at our company is traffic accident insurance.

examples.chinese: 昨晚我接了好幾通沒有聲音的電話，真的很討厭。
examples.pinyin: Zuówǎn wǒ jiē le hǎo jǐ tōng méiyǒu shēngyīn de diànhuà, zhēn de hěn tǎoyàn.
examples.english: Last night I received several silent phone calls; it was really annoying.

examples.chinese: 我已經退休了，不過還時常跟幾位要好的同事通信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng tuìxiū le, bùguò hái shícháng gēn jǐ wèi yàohǎo de tóngshì tōngxìn.
examples.english: I have already retired, but I still often correspond with a few close colleagues.

examples.chinese: 這幾年由於市長積極實行交通建設計畫，使當地交通情況明顯改善了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ nián yóuyú shìzhǎng jījí shíxíng jiāotōng jiànshè jìhuà, shǐ dāngdì jiāotōng qíngkuàng míngxiǎn gǎishàn le.
examples.english: In recent years, because the mayor actively implemented a transportation construction plan, the local traffic situation has obviously improved.

examples.chinese: 去郵局領包裹的時候，記得帶身分證、圖章還有通知單。
examples.pinyin: Qù yóujú lǐng bāoguǒ de shíhou, jìde dài shēnfènzhèng, túzhāng hái yǒu tōngzhīdān.
examples.english: When going to the post office to pick up a parcel, remember to bring your ID card, seal, and notification slip.

examples.chinese: 這些跟卡通人物有關書籍，很適合兒童閱讀。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē gēn kǎtōng rénwù yǒuguān de shūjí, hěn shìhé értóng yuèdú.
examples.english: These books related to cartoon characters are very suitable for children to read.

examples.chinese: 在交通不方便的地區上班，得一大早就出門才行。
examples.pinyin: Zài jiāotōng bù fāngbiàn de dìqū shàngbān, děi yīdàzǎo jiù chūmén cái xíng.
examples.english: To work in an area with inconvenient transportation, you have to leave early in the morning.

examples.chinese: 他的夢想是利用水來當作交通工具的燃料，可是很多人認為不可能。
examples.pinyin: Tā de mèngxiǎng shì lìyòng shuǐ lái dāngzuò jiāotōng gōngjù de ránliào, kěshì hěn duō rén rènwéi bù kěnéng.
examples.english: His dream is to use water as fuel for transportation vehicles, but many people think it is impossible.

examples.chinese: 大型體育活動常選擇在都市舉行，主要原因是交通方便。
examples.pinyin: Dàxíng tǐyù huódòng cháng xuǎnzé zài dūshì jǔxíng, zhǔyào yuányīn shì jiāotōng fāngbiàn.
examples.english: Large-scale sports events are often chosen to be held in cities; the main reason is convenient transportation.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議改時間了，你趕緊通知大家。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì gǎi shíjiān le, nǐ gǎnjǐn tōngzhī dàjiā.
examples.english: Tomorrow's meeting has been rescheduled; you hurry and notify everyone.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方距離公司很近，省了很多時間與交通費。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng jùlí gōngsī hěn jìn, shěng le hěn duō shíjiān yǔ jiāotōngfèi.
examples.english: The place where I live is very close to the company, which saves a lot of time and transportation costs.

examples.chinese: 我通常在家吃晚餐，只有好朋友邀請我吃飯，才會出門。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tōngcháng zài jiā chī wǎncān, zhǐyǒu hǎo péngyǒu yāoqǐng wǒ chīfàn, cái huì chūmén.
examples.english: I usually eat dinner at home; only when a good friend invites me to eat do I go out.

examples.chinese: 新型筆電銷售時價格通常比較貴，有時倒不如買符合個人需要的舊型筆電。
examples.pinyin: Xīnxíng bǐdiàn xiāoshòu shí jiàgé tōngcháng bǐjiào guì, yǒushí dào bùrú mǎi fúhé gèrén xūyào de jiùxíng bǐdiàn.
examples.english: When new-model laptops are sold, the price is usually relatively expensive; sometimes it would be better to buy an old-model laptop that fits one's personal needs.

examples.chinese: 幸福的婚姻不僅需要觀念的溝通，更需要感情的交流。
examples.pinyin: Xìngfú de hūnyīn bùjǐn xūyào guānniàn de gōutōng, gèng xūyào gǎnqíng de jiāoliú.
examples.english: A happy marriage not only requires communication of ideas but even more requires an exchange of feelings.

examples.chinese: 公司不斷推銷新型電子產品，通常是為了刺激客戶購買。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī bùduàn tuīxiāo xīnxíng diànzǐ chǎnpǐn, tōngcháng shì wèile cìjī kèhù gòumǎi.
examples.english: Companies constantly promote new types of electronic products, usually in order to stimulate customers to buy.

examples.chinese: 個性親切、大方，通常是從事服務業的最佳人才。
examples.pinyin: Gèxìng qīnqiè, dàfāng, tōngcháng shì cóngshì fúwùyè de zuìjiā réncái.
examples.english: People with a friendly and generous personality are usually the best talent for working in the service industry.

examples.chinese: 他用很珍貴的茶具來泡品質很普通的茶葉，真浪費。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng hěn zhēnguì de chájù lái pào pǐnzhí hěn pǔtōng de cháyè, zhēn làngfèi.
examples.english: He uses very precious tea utensils to brew tea leaves of very ordinary quality; what a waste.

examples.chinese: 都市人口如果過度成長，容易引發環保及交通問題。
examples.pinyin: Dūshì rénkǒu rúguǒ guòdù chéngzhǎng, róngyì yǐnfā huánbǎo jí jiāotōng wèntí.
examples.english: If urban population grows excessively, it easily leads to environmental and traffic problems.

examples.chinese: 路上安裝紅綠燈，是要保障民眾的交通安全。
examples.pinyin: Lùshàng ānzhuāng hónglǜdēng, shì yào bǎozhàng mínzhòng de jiāotōng ānquán.
examples.english: Installing traffic lights on the road is to safeguard the public's traffic safety.

examples.chinese: 在觀光景點銷售紀念品，價格通常比一般商店高一些。
examples.pinyin: Zài guānguāng jǐngdiǎn xiāoshòu jìniànpǐn, jiàgé tōngcháng bǐ yībān shāngdiàn gāo yīxiē.
examples.english: Souvenirs sold at tourist attractions are usually a bit more expensive than those in regular stores.

examples.chinese: 錯誤通常來自粗心，因此無論事情大小都該用心處理。
examples.pinyin: Cuòwù tōngcháng láizì cūxīn, yīncǐ wúlùn shìqíng dàxiǎo dōu gāi yòngxīn chǔlǐ.
examples.english: Mistakes usually come from carelessness, so no matter how big or small the matter is, it should be handled with care.

examples.chinese: 通常第一名只有一位，但有時也會出現例外的情況。
examples.pinyin: Tōngcháng dì yī míng zhǐyǒu yī wèi, dàn yǒushí yě huì chūxiàn lìwài de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: Usually there is only one first place, but sometimes there are exceptions.

items.wordHook: a 辶(movement) road takes the 甬(path) forward → traffic will 通(pass through).

examples.chinese: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
examples.english: Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 總統到地震災區慰問災民，並保證會協助他們恢復正常的生活。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng dào dìzhèn zāiqū wèiwèn zāimín, bìng bǎozhèng huì xiézhù tāmen huīfù zhèngcháng de shēnghuó.
examples.english: The president went to the earthquake disaster area to express sympathy and solicitude for the victims, and promised to help them restore a normal life.

items.wordHook: Combining 災(disaster) and 民(citizens): 災民 means disaster victims.

examples.chinese: 這家超市賣的商品都是安全的，讓顧客買得安心、吃得安心，用的也安心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì mài de shāngpǐn dōu shì ānquán de, ràng gùkè mǎi de ānxīn, chī de ānxīn, yòng de yě ānxīn.
examples.english: The products sold at this supermarket are all safe, allowing customers to buy with peace of mind, eat with peace of mind, and use with peace of mind.

examples.chinese: 何老闆替公司建立了良好的制度，讓員工都能安心地工作。
examples.pinyin: Hé lǎobǎn tì gōngsī jiànlì le liánghǎo de zhìdù, ràng yuángōng dōu néng ānxīn de gōngzuò.
examples.english: Boss He established a good system for the company, allowing employees to work with peace of mind.

examples.chinese: 想吃得安心、吃得健康，自己親手做是必需的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng chī de ānxīn, chī de jiànkāng, zìjǐ qīnshǒu zuò shì bìxū de.
examples.english: If you want to eat with peace of mind and eat healthily, making it yourself is necessary.

examples.chinese: 國外旅行時隨時攜帶護照、信用卡，可讓你玩得安心又順利。
examples.pinyin: Guówài lǚxíng shí suíshí xiédài hùzhào, xìnyòngkǎ, kě ràng nǐ wán de ānxīn yòu shùnlì.
examples.english: When traveling abroad, carrying your passport and credit card at all times can let you have fun with peace of mind and smoothly.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡玻璃做的杯子，用起來比較安心，看起來也很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān bōli zuò de bēizi, yòng qǐlái bǐjiào ānxīn, kàn qǐlái yě hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: I like cups made of glass; they feel safer to use, and they look pretty too.

examples.chinese: 自己做的肥皂用起來比較安心，也能選擇自己喜歡的氣味。
examples.pinyin: Zìjǐ zuò de féizào yòng qǐlái bǐjiào ānxīn, yě néng xuǎnzé zìjǐ xǐhuan de qìwèi.
examples.english: Soap made by yourself feels safer to use, and you can also choose the scent you like.

examples.chinese: 為了使客戶安心使用，我們公司產品訂了嚴格的生產標準。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ kèhù ānxīn shǐyòng, wǒmen gōngsī chǎnpǐn dìng le yángé de shēngchǎn biāozhǔn.
examples.english: In order to let customers use them with peace of mind, our company has set strict production standards for its products.

examples.chinese: 他失業了，但妻子三人卻仍在一旁支持著他，讓他安心了不少。
examples.pinyin: Tā shīyè le, dàn qīzi sān rén què réng zài yīpáng zhīchí zhe tā, ràng tā ānxīn le bùshǎo.
examples.english: He lost his job, but his wife and three children still supported him on the side, which made him feel much more at ease.

items.wordHook: Combining 安(peaceful) and 心(heart): 安心 means feel at ease.

examples.chinese: 要維持社區良好的生活品質，就要從不亂丟垃圾、減少家庭噪音做起。
examples.pinyin: Yào wéichí shèqū liánghǎo de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, jiù yào cóng bù luàn diū lèsè, jiǎnshǎo jiātíng zàoyīn zuò qǐ.
examples.english: To maintain a good quality of life in the community, we must start by not littering and reducing household noise.

examples.chinese: 他為了演好健身教練的角色，透過運動與調整飲食，讓身體維持在最佳的狀態。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile yǎn hǎo jiànshēn jiàoliàn de juésè, tòuguò yùndòng yǔ tiáozhěng yǐnshí, ràng shēntǐ wéichí zài zuìjiā de zhuàngtài.
examples.english: In order to play the role of a fitness coach well, he keeps his body in the best condition through exercise and diet adjustment.

examples.chinese:
理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。
著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin:
Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng.
Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english:
In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation.
The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

examples.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

examples.chinese: 他與妻子雖然已結婚多年，感情仍維持得很好，真令人羨慕。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǔ qīzi suīrán yǐ jiéhūn duō nián, gǎnqíng réng wéichí de hěn hǎo, zhēn lìng rén xiànmù.
examples.english: Although he and his wife have been married for many years, their affection is still maintained very well; it truly makes people envious.

items.wordHook: Combining 維(preserve) and 持(hold): 維持 means maintain.

examples.chinese: 公司交給你的支票記得要收好，別弄丟了。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jiāo gěi nǐ de zhīpiào jìde yào shōu hǎo, bié nòngdiū le.
examples.english: Remember to put away the check the company gave you properly; don't lose it.

examples.chinese: 那家商店不只賣日用品，另外也賣食品和文具。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā shāngdiàn bùzhǐ mài rìyòngpǐn, lìngwài yě mài shípǐn hé wénjù.
examples.english: That store not only sells daily necessities; in addition, it also sells food and stationery.

examples.chinese: 在大都市，早上起床能聽見鳥叫聲，那真是太難得了。
examples.pinyin: Zài dà dūshì, zǎoshang qǐchuáng néng tīngjiàn niǎo jiào shēng, nà zhēn shì tài nándé le.
examples.english: In a big city, being able to hear the sound of birds chirping when you get up in the morning is truly rare.

examples.chinese: 每次比賽到了緊張的時候，觀眾就大聲叫喊，我也跟著喊。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì bǐsài dào le jǐnzhāng de shíhòu, guānzhòng jiù dàshēng jiàohǎn, wǒ yě gēnzhe hǎn.
examples.english: Every time the game reaches a tense moment, the audience shouts loudly, and I shout along too.

examples.chinese: 當聽到周博士多年的研究終於有了成果時，所有員工都給他最大的掌聲。
examples.pinyin: Dāng tīngdào Zhōu bóshì duōnián de yánjiū zhōngyú yǒu le chéngguǒ shí, suǒyǒu yuángōng dōu gěi tā zuì dà de zhǎngshēng.
examples.english: When they heard that Dr. Zhou's years of research had finally produced results, all the employees gave him the biggest applause.

examples.chinese: 當周圍環境很靜的時候，可以聽見平常聽不到的聲音。
examples.pinyin: Dāng zhōuwéi huánjìng hěn jìng de shíhou, kěyǐ tīngjiàn píngcháng tīng bù dào de shēngyīn.
examples.english: When the surrounding environment is very quiet, you can hear sounds that you normally cannot hear.

examples.chinese: 昨晚我接了好幾通沒有聲音的電話，真的很討厭。
examples.pinyin: Zuówǎn wǒ jiē le hǎo jǐ tōng méiyǒu shēngyīn de diànhuà, zhēn de hěn tǎoyàn.
examples.english: Last night I received several silent phone calls; it was really annoying.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese:
那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。
這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin:
Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi.
Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english:
The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically.
This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese:
公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。
地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin:
Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng.
Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english:
The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it.
Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 我在山上工作，手機的訊號很弱，朋友常抱怨我的電話不是打不通，就是聲音不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài shānshàng gōngzuò, shǒujī de xìnhào hěn ruò, péngyǒu cháng bàoyuàn wǒ de diànhuà bú shì dǎ bù tōng, jiù shì shēngyīn bù qīngchu.
examples.english: I work in the mountains, and the cell phone signal is very weak. My friends often complain that my phone either can't be reached or the voice is unclear.

examples.chinese: 當軍隊一到達災區，就聽到了求救的聲音，所以立刻開始救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Dāng jūnduì yí dàodá zāiqū, jiù tīngdào le qiújiù de shēngyīn, suǒyǐ lìkè kāishǐ jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: As soon as the military arrived at the disaster area, they heard calls for help, so they immediately began disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 昨天晚上的風雨聲好可怕，讓我整個晚上都沒睡好。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng de fēngyǔ shēng hǎo kěpà, ràng wǒ zhěnggè wǎnshàng dōu méi shuì hǎo.
examples.english: Last night the sound of wind and rain was so scary that it kept me from sleeping well the whole night.

examples.chinese: 舅舅對我很好，不管我遇到什麼挑戰，只要跟他說一聲，他一定會幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Jiùjiu duì wǒ hěn hǎo, bùguǎn wǒ yùdào shénme tiǎozhàn, zhǐyào gēn tā shuō yì shēng, tā yídìng huì bāngmáng.
examples.english: My uncle is very good to me; no matter what challenges I encounter, as long as I give him a mention, he will definitely help.

examples.chinese: 鞭炮的聲音很可怕，把孩子嚇得哭起來了。等半夜十二點的鐘聲一響，我們就要放鞭炮慶祝新年了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. 2. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiù yào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.chinese: 我聽見樓下有奇怪的聲音，是不是有小偷啊？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tīngjiàn lóuxià yǒu qíguài de shēngyīn, shìbushì yǒu xiǎotōu a?
examples.english: I hear a strange sound downstairs—is there a thief?

examples.chinese: 很多外國學生弄不清楚漢字的聲調。
examples.pinyin: Hěnduō wàiguó xuéshēng nòng bù qīngchǔ Hànzì de shēngdiào.
examples.english: Many foreign students cannot get the tones of Chinese characters clear.

examples.chinese: 有的日本學生覺得寫漢字不難，可是漢語的聲調很難。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
examples.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

examples.chinese: 有的日本學生覺得寫漢字不難，可是漢語的聲調很難。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
examples.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

examples.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
examples.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

examples.chinese: 外面的風很大，聲音聽起來很可怕。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn de fēng hěn dà, shēngyīn tīng qǐlái hěn kěpà.
examples.english: The wind outside is very strong; the sound sounds very scary.

examples.chinese: 弟弟半夜在房間聽音樂，聲音很吵。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi bànyè zài fángjiān tīng yīnyuè, shēngyīn hěn chǎo.
examples.english: My little brother listens to music in his room in the middle of the night, and the sound is very noisy.

examples.chinese: 你聽，這是什聲音？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng, zhè shì shénme shēngyīn?
examples.english: Listen, what sound is this?

examples.chinese: 兒子跟女兒都在睡覺，你不要說得太大聲。
examples.pinyin: Érzi gēn nǚ'ér dōu zài shuìjiào, nǐ búyào shuō de tài dàshēng.
examples.english: Both my son and daughter are sleeping; don't speak too loudly.

examples.chinese: 每天早上都有人在附近公園大聲唱流行歌，聽久了真的很煩。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang dōu yǒu rén zài fùjìn gōngyuán dàshēng chàng liúxínggē, tīng jiǔ le zhēn de hěn fán.
examples.english: Every morning someone sings pop songs loudly in the nearby park; after hearing it for a long time, it's really annoying.

examples.chinese: 伯父的孩子是對雙胞胎，不只是樣子，連說話的聲音都像。
examples.pinyin: Bófù de háizi shì duì shuāngbāotāi, bù zhǐshì yàngzi, lián shuōhuà de shēngyīn dōu xiàng.
examples.english: My uncle's children are a pair of twins; not only do they look alike, even their speaking voices are similar.

examples.chinese: 這位郵差的聲音很大，每次他來送信，整條街全都聽見了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yóuchāi de shēngyīn hěn dà, měi cì tā lái sòng xìn, zhěng tiáo jiē quán dōu tīngjiàn le.
examples.english: This postman's voice is very loud; every time he comes to deliver mail, the whole street hears it.

examples.chinese: 能得到觀眾熱情掌聲的表演，才算是有魅力的表演。
examples.pinyin: Néng dédào guānzhòng rèqíng zhǎngshēng de biǎoyǎn, cái suànshì yǒu mèilì de biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: Only a performance that can receive enthusiastic applause from the audience is considered to be a charming performance.

examples.chinese: 手機鬧鐘的音量及音樂聲，都可按照個人的使用習慣來調整。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī nàozhōng de yīnliàng jí yīnyuè shēng, dōu kě ànzhào gèrén de shǐyòng xíguàn lái tiáozhěng.
examples.english: The volume of the mobile phone alarm and the sound of the music can both be adjusted according to personal usage habits.

examples.chinese: 根據醫院規定，進入病房後禁止大聲說話。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù yīyuàn guīdìng, jìnrù bìngfáng hòu jìnzhǐ dàshēng shuōhuà.
examples.english: According to hospital regulations, after entering the ward, speaking loudly is prohibited.

examples.chinese: 要是你對文藝領域不了解，最好不要隨便批評別人的作品。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ duì wényì lǐngyù bù liǎojiě, zuìhǎo bùyào suíbiàn pīpíng biérén de zuòpǐn.
examples.english: If you don't understand the field of literature and art, you'd better not casually criticize others' works.

examples.chinese: 從事新工作時往往經驗不足，因此向別人請教是必需的。
examples.pinyin: Cóngshì xīn gōngzuò shí wǎngwǎng jīngyàn bùzú, yīncǐ xiàng biérén qǐngjiào shì bìxū de.
examples.english: When starting a new job, one often lacks experience, so asking others for advice is necessary.

items.wordHook: A 亻(person) who 盡(uses up) every last drop of strength, down to the final breath, is 儘(exhaust).
A 囗(box) packs everything 專(concentrated) and tight, so it forms a 團(sphere).
Combining 廣(broad) and 播(play): 廣播 means broadcast.
